Opposition March in Delhi Halts Traffic, Security Tightened

An opposition protest march in Delhi caused significant traffic disruptions, with roads in Lutyens' Delhi shut and traffic moving "at a snail's pace" on adjoining stretches. Police halted the march and tightened security around the Election Commission of India (ECI) headquarters. The event led to traffic crawling on nearby roads.
